newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First postpones political talks to meet Brash.
newsitem.headline: NZ First postpones political talks to meet Brash.

text.p: New Zealand First said on Thursday it was deferring scheduled coalition talks with both the National Party and Labour scheduled for today "to have a crucial meeting with economic advisers", spokesman Mike Booker said.
NZ First leader Winston Peters said his party negotiators would meet Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash at 3.30 p.m.
Today's meeting with National has been postponed from 10.00 a.m. until 5.00 p.m. while the Labour Party meeting has been postponed from 2.00 p.m. until 7.30 p.m.
NZ First holds the balance of power following the October 12 election and has been in talks with the two main parties about forming a government.
